description: This file defines theme-related functions for a frontend project, including a theme token provider (getOceanTheme) and color palette utilities (getCategoricalPalette, getCategoryColorMap). It exports functions used for styling and color management within the project.

methods.name: getOceanTheme
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens, including colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette
methods.description: Generates a deterministic color palette for categorical data, seeded by Ocean theme colors, with logic to extend the palette if more categories are needed.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap
methods.description: Maps category names to colors from the categorical palette, ensuring consistent color assignment.
